name: slack_list_channels
description: Lists public channels in the workspace (or fixed list from SLACK_CHANNEL_IDS).

name: slack_get_channel_history
description: Returns the most recent N messages from a channel, including message text and timestamps.

name: slack_get_thread_replies
description: Returns all replies in a message thread, given the parent message timestamp.

name: slack_post_message
description: Posts a new message as the bot to any Slack channel the bot has been added to.

name: slack_reply_to_thread
description: Posts a reply to an existing message thread.

name: slack_add_reaction
description: Adds an emoji reaction to a specific message.

name: slack_get_users
description: Returns a paginated list of all workspace users.

name: slack_get_user_profile
description: Returns the detailed Slack profile for a single user.
